> [This domain is for use in documentation examples without needing permission. Avoid use in operations.](embed:example.com-1)

The webpage at [Example Domain](embed:example.com-1) is a placeholder managed by [IANA](wiki:Internet_Assigned_Numbers_Authority) (the Internet Assigned Numbers Authority). It serves as a reserved domain that authors and developers can freely use in documentation, tutorials, and examples without having to coordinate or seek permission. 

You can read more about it directly on the [IANA website](https://iana.org/domains/example).

***

**Would you like to explore next?**
1. Learn how placeholder domains like `example.com`, `example.net`, and `example.org` are managed by [ICANN](wiki:ICANN).
2. Look into how domain registration and documentation standards work.
